question.text: When the two were discussing meeting for a meal, what was the name of the Sichuan restaurant that Zhou Pingfan found?

questions.validation_notes: The third scenario in Multimodal (Text-Image) Causal Inference: Given an image, the question asks what conclusion someone has drawn based on the image. The answer combines price judgments prompted by the image and environmental inquiries, requiring inference.
